translationRepairs: He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahadak and recovered the counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahada and recovered the counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
Chinese 拉哈達克松陽 treats 克 as the verb “recover/take”; the personal name is 拉哈達 (Lahada), not Lahadak.
He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahadak and recovered the two counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahada and recovered the two counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
Same name error: 拉哈達 is Lahada; 克 belongs to the following verb phrase.
When Jin Shengchuan rebelled, bandits overran most of the prefectures and counties, but Pingxiang alone remained intact because it had been prepared.
When Jin Shenghuan rebelled, bandits overran most of the prefectures and counties, but Pingxiang alone remained intact because it had been prepared.
金聲桓 is Jin Shenghuan; Shengchuan misreads 桓.
He was soon restored to office for his defensive merit, appointed magistrate of Daying in Shanxi, and then transferred to prefect of Yizhou in Shandong.
He was soon restored to office for his defensive merit, appointed magistrate of Daning in Shanxi, and then transferred to prefect of Yizhou in Shandong.
大寧 is Daning, not Daying.
Xingzuo, having purchased office as a student, was appointed magistrate of Pingxiang in Jiangxi.
Xingzuo, starting from the status of a tribute student (gongsheng), was appointed magistrate of Pingxiang in Jiangxi.
自貢生 means from being a 貢生, not that he purchased the magistracy as a student.
When Wen Dai arrived, Yao Qisheng told him that Wan Zhengse had retaken Haitan only after making a prior deal with Zhu Tian Gui, and that no enemy had been killed in its capture.
When Wen Dai arrived, Yao Qisheng told him that Wan Zhengse had retaken Haitan only after making a prior deal with Zhu Tiangui, and that no enemy had been killed in its capture.
Name should be Zhu Tiangui to match 朱天貴.

In the thirty-fifth year the Emperor marched against Galdan and ordered supply stations established from Hutai Heshuo to the thirteen stations at Ningxia An. Xingzuo volunteered for duty and was posted at Shakushu'er station; before long his original rank was restored.

In the thirty-fifth year the Emperor marched against Galdan and ordered thirteen relay stations established from Hutanhueshuo to Ningxia; Xingzuo volunteered for duty and was posted at Shakeshuer station; before long his original rank was restored.
寧夏安十三塘 means establishing thirteen stations to Ningxia, not a place named Ningxia An.
His achievements were recognized, and he was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief.
His achievements were recognized, and he was promoted to Right Dudu (you dudu).
右都督 is a military rank (Right Dudu), not Right Censor-in-Chief.
The Emperor called in the court ministers for counsel. Grand Secretary Li Huo advised that Lang's proposal should be adopted.
The Emperor called in the court ministers for counsel. Grand Secretary Li Wei advised that Lang's proposal should be adopted.
李霨 is Li Wei (Wèi), not Li Huo.
The enemy met them with their full strength; the commanders Lin Xian and Zhu Tianguian broke in first, and Tianguian fell in the fighting.
The enemy met them with their full strength; the commanders Lin Xian and Zhu Tiangui broke in first, and Tiangui fell in the fighting.
朱天貴 is Zhu Tiangui; Tianguian is a misspelling.
In the seventh month a comet appeared, and Minister of Revenue Liang Qingbiao raised the matter again; an edict then temporarily halted the advance.
In the seventh month a comet appeared, and Minister of Liang Qingbiao, Minister of Revenue raised the matter again; an edict then temporarily halted the advance.
Fused title+name "Revenue Liang Qingbiao" should separate office and personal name.
Zhu Tianguai came from Putian in Fujian.
Zhu Tiangui came from Putian in Fujian.
When Lang attacked Penghu, Tianguai brought his troops to join the campaign.
When Lang attacked Penghu, Tiangui brought his troops to join the campaign.

Guoxuan resisted fiercely. Tianguai closed on the enemy works with twelve boats, set their ships afire, and killed or wounded a great many. He fought all the harder until a cannonball struck him down in his vessel; even then he shouted to kill the rebels before he died. He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Zhongzhuang.
